subject: Cloud Computing
title: BigQuery and the Data Edge
description: A quick, practical guide to BigQuery and the Data Edge.

hook.text: Run a SQL query across a petabyte of data and get results in seconds. That's BigQuery.

buildup.text: Google built BigQuery on technology it uses internally to analyze billions of web pages daily.

discovery.text: It separates storage from compute, so you only pay for queries — not for keeping a cluster running.

twist.text: BigQuery is often the reason companies choose Google Cloud. It's a killer app that pulls in other services.

climax.text: In data analytics, Google Cloud genuinely leads. BigQuery set the standard competitors try to match.

punchline.text: BigQuery proves that one great product can anchor a whole cloud.

quiz.question: What makes BigQuery architecturally different from traditional databases?
options: It separates storage from compute, so you pay only for queries
It stores all data in your local browser for faster access
It requires a dedicated cluster running 24/7 to function

details.summary: BigQuery is Google Cloud's serverless data warehouse that can analyze petabytes of data in seconds without managing any infrastructure. Its separation of storage and compute, automatic scaling, and SQL interface make it one of the most popular reasons organizations choose Google Cloud.
details.whyItMatters: BigQuery exemplifies what cloud-native architecture can achieve. It handles massive data analytics workloads that would require teams of engineers and expensive hardware to replicate on-premises.
takeaways: BigQuery analyzes petabytes in seconds without infrastructure management
Storage and compute scale independently for cost efficiency
It is a primary reason organizations choose Google Cloud

faq.question: How does BigQuery pricing work?
faq.answer: BigQuery charges separately for storage and queries. Storage costs about $0.02 per GB per month. Query pricing is either on-demand at $5 per TB scanned or flat-rate with reserved capacity. Separation of storage and compute means you pay only when actively querying.

faq.question: What makes BigQuery different from other data warehouses?
faq.answer: BigQuery is fully serverless with no infrastructure to manage, scales automatically to handle any query size, and uses columnar storage with built-in ML capabilities. It can query data directly in Cloud Storage without loading it, and supports real-time streaming ingestion.
